evidence: Labeled Mining and modifies interfaces::Mining and Cap'n Proto mining definitions in src/interfaces/mining.h and src/ipc/capnp/mining.capnp.
rationale: It replaces clumsy out-of-band interrupt methods with cancellation arguments on blocking mining interface methods like waitTipChanged and waitNext, resolving RFC #33575. This stabilizes and streamlines the interface relied upon by external mining consumers such as Stratum v2 template providers.
